incident-bot: PAGE FIRED: edge.healthcheck (severity: P2) — multiple TLS handshake failures + LB target unhealthy in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Paging sre-oncall-ari. PagerDuty: pd-incident-1765012345

sre-oncall-ari: Acked. jumping in. any immediate customer reports?

support-dave: seeing increase in 504/524 for API requests from EU and APAC customers, chat integrations timing out. tickets coming in from a few enterprise customers.

eng-frank: Observed upstream logs: repeated "handshake_failure" from edge -> backend. LB health checks failing on backend targets in eu-west-1. TL;DR: backend hosts healthy but TLS negotiation failing after client hello.

netops-ben: I see a correlated spike in DNS resolution delays for edge endpoints in APAC — looks like an intermediate resolver cache returned stale A records pointing to old edge nodes (TTL ~ 300 but some caches ignoring). Could be propagation + our recent weight changes.

product-elena: Customer impact estimate? SRE teams need to classify for comms.

eng-frank: Early estimate: ~5-8% of requests in EU/APAC experiencing timeouts over last 7m. Not global. Might be routing to a small subset of edge proxies with bad cert rotation state.

incident-bot: Auto-run diagnostics:
```
edge-proxy-health --regions eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --check tls,targets
# results: TLS_NEGOTIATION_ERRORS=47, BACKEND_5xx=3, HEALTHCHECK_FAIL=12
```

sre-oncall-ari: Plan: 1) shift traffic off unhealthy LB targets (weight shift) 2) purge edge DNS caches for affected POPs 3) trigger cert revalidate on suspect proxies 4) monitor for rollback triggers. Starting weight shift now.

netops-ben: Executing weight adjustment (canary -> full fallback) to route traffic to eu-central-1 and us-west-2 while we investigate. Command: `rctl lb weights set edge-eu-west-1 --decrease 80% --fallback eu-central-1`

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by sre-oncall-ari. Escalation suppressed.

eng-frank: Running remote cert-check on suspect proxy nodes in eu-west-1:
```
openssl s_client -connect proxy-12.eu-west-1.redwood:443 -servername proxy-12.eu-west-1.redwood < /dev/null | grep "Verify return code"
# Verify return code: 0 (ok)
```
But several nodes show `handshake timeout` in the TLS debug. Might be mismatched cipher negotiation after a kernel patch on a small host pool.

netops-ben: Purging CDN/DNS caches for ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-1 via internal purge: `cdnctl purge --pop ap-southeast-1,eu-west-1 --key edge-*` — kicked off. Expect propagation ~30s-2m for most resolvers.

support-dave: Noted customers with open tickets: AcmeCorp, FableAI. Raising priority comms: we should send an interim status to impacted customers.

product-elena: Agreed. Please include ETA for full mitigation and what customers will see (retries, transient timeouts).

eng-frank: After weight shift, 1m telemetry: TLS errors down 70% for EU; APAC still ~40% impacted pending cache flush. Backend 5xx stable.

sre-oncall-ari: Good. Next: I want a targeted cert rotate on the failing proxy group as precaution: `infractl cert rotate --hosts proxy-{10..15}.eu-west-1` — doing in small batches.

netops-ben: Cert rotate started. Doing two hosts at a time to keep capacity.

incident-bot: Automated escalation timer paused while acknowledged. Next auto-check in 5m.

eng-frank: Noting a recurring pattern: stale resolver entries + aggressive OS-level TLS settings on small hostpool -> handshake mismatch. Logged: INV-1765012345 for postmortem.

support-dave: Sent short interim to impacted customers: "We're investigating intermittent TLS errors in EU/APAC affecting API calls. We've routed traffic away from affected nodes and are working on a fix; retrying requests should succeed. We'll update in 30 minutes." :email:

sre-oncall-ari: After second batch of cert rotates, telemetry shows APAC error rate dropping to low single digits. EU recovered. Rolling back weight shift gradually to normal over 10m to reintroduce capacity.

product-elena: Please confirm whether any data loss or request replays occurred for customers.

eng-frank: No evidence of request loss at application layer. Some client requests timed out and retried — that's expected. No message queueing failures.

support-dave: Closing customer tickets as "monitoring/backfill" if they confirm recovery; will escalate individually if not.

netops-ben: Leaving a note: we should increase edge DNS TTL hygiene and add resolver diversity checks. Filed follow-up: TKT-8242.

sre-oncall-ari: Marking incident as mitigated. Keeping channel open for 30m monitoring. If stable, we will resolve the PD incident and start postmortem. Thanks all — nice coordination. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved by sre-oncall-ari. Timeline: mitigated at 1765012910.

incident-bot: Post-incident checklist: attach logs, timeline, customer impact summary, and assign postmortem owner.

eng-frank: Assigned postmortem owner: eng-frank. Initial notes: cause = resolver propagation + partial cert negotiation mismatch. Next: recreate in staging, add additional TLS ciphers to compatibility matrix, and harden upgrade playbook for kernel/openssl updates.

support-dave: Final customer comm draft ready.

sre-oncall-ari: Thanks team — closing thread in 30.

product-elena: Follow-up: include runbook updates and a blameless postmortem.

sre-oncall-ari: +1. Closing now. :lock:
